name: @h081lll/mcp

tools.name: h081_bank_deposit
tools.description: Deposit USDG from the agent wallet into its private (shielded) H081 bank account on Solana. The chain sees the depositor and the amount; the shielded balance and every later move inside the bank are private. Caps (read from chain before any proof is made): at most 1,000 USDG per deposit and 10,000 USDG in the bank in total; deposits can be paused by the config authority, withdrawals never. Needs ~0.02 SOL in the agent wallet for buffer rent (refunded) and fees. Give `amount` (base units, 6 decimals) or `usdg` (decimal). H081 Capital is live on Solana mainnet, not audited yet; use at your own risk.

inputSchema.description: exactly one of amount (base units) or usdg (decimal)

tools.name: h081_bank_withdraw
tools.description: Withdraw USDG from the shielded account to a Solana wallet (default: the agent wallet). By default the relayer sends the transaction and takes its fee out of the amount: max(0.05 USDG, 0.20%) of the public amount, paid to the protocol treasury (checked before anything is proven); the chain then does not link the agent wallet to the withdrawal. If the relayer is unreachable or refuses, the withdrawal is NOT sent and the error says why; it is never silently sent by the agent key. Above the relayer's anonymous free tier (100 USDG per 30 days today) the agent wallet is named to the relayer as capacity operator, which needs H081 staked in capacity_stake (`h081_stake`); otherwise split the withdrawal or go direct. `direct: true` has the agent key send it instead (no relay fee, no limit, but the agent wallet is visible on chain as the sender). Give `amount` or `usdg`. H081 Capital is live on Solana mainnet, not audited yet; use at your own risk.

to.description: recipient wallet (default: the agent wallet); must be a wallet, not a token account or program

direct.description: true: the agent key sends the withdrawal itself (no relay fee, no free-tier limit, sender visible on chain); default false: through the relayer, refused (not sent) when the relayer is unavailable

inputSchema.description: exactly one of amount (base units) or usdg (decimal)

tools.name: h081_bank_balance
tools.description: The shielded USDG balance of the agent's H081 bank account (visible only to this key), its agent allowances, the wallet's public USDG and SOL balances, and the current deposit caps. Read-only.

tools.name: h081_loan_quote
tools.description: Price a stream-backed loan without sending anything. From a lender's `h081-loan-terms:` code (or `pledgeBps` and `minRemaining` directly) it returns the largest principal that pledge can back (minRemaining * pledgeBps / 10000), the 0.25% origination fee the protocol takes out of the payout, and the payout. With `loanRef` it also reads the slot's on-chain status (funded, principal, repaid, expiry). There is no on-chain offer book: terms come from a lender off-chain. Read-only.

termsCode.description: a lender's "h081-loan-terms:" code (gives pledgeBps and the slot)

minRemaining.description: the allowance budget the proof will state (base units)

pledgeBps.description: share of every payment routed to the lender, basis points

principal.description: a principal to price (base units); default: the maximum

loanRef.description: loan slot number to read on chain

tools.name: h081_loan_borrow
tools.description: Pledge an agent allowance to a lender's loan slot and produce the proof the lender funds against. The agent's shielded balance funds an allowance of `budget` USDG to a sub-account that unlocks as a stream over `unlockDays`, with `pledgeBps` of every payment from it routed to the lender (from the terms code), then makes the stream proof and returns it as an `h081-loan-proof:` code. Hand that code to the lender: when they fund the slot, the principal minus the 0.25% origination fee lands in the agent wallet's USDG account. This is a two-party flow with no automatic matching: without a lender who funds, nothing is borrowed. Needs the grant (44 MB) and stream circuits. H081 Capital is live on Solana mainnet, not audited yet; use at your own risk.

budget.description: allowance budget taken from the shielded balance (base units)

dailyCap.description: most the sub-account may pay per day (base units); default: no daily cap

maxPerTx.description: most per payment (base units); default: no per-payment cap

days.description: lifetime of the allowance in days

unlockDays.description: the budget unlocks linearly over this many days (<= days)

agentIndex.description: which sub-account to use (default: the first free one)

inputSchema.description: exactly one of budget (base units) or budgetUsdg (decimal)

tools.name: h081_stake
tools.description: capacity_stake: stake H081 from the agent wallet to earn relayer capacity (desks and shield capacity: how much the relayer relays for this wallet per 30 days above the anonymous free tier, used by h081_bank_withdraw), request unstake (30-day cooldown), unstake after the cooldown, or `view` the position. Caps: 100,000 H081 per stake, 1,000,000 H081 total. Give `amount` (base units, 6 decimals) or `h081` (decimal) for stake / request_unstake. H081 Capital is live on Solana mainnet, not audited yet; use at your own risk.

amount.description: base units (H081 has 6 decimals), for stake / request_unstake

tools.name: h081_protocol_info
tools.description: Static and live facts about the H081 Capital bank: cluster, program ids, USDG and H081 mints, deposit caps and pause flag read from chain, relayer terms and status, the agent wallet and shielded address, how the shielded account secret is derived, where the proving artifacts live, and the risk notice. Reports only the RPC host, never the full RPC URL. Read-only.

instructions: H081 Capital: a private bank for AI agents on Solana. The agent key this server holds pays fees, holds USDG and owns a shielded bank account. Deposits are public on chain (depositor and amount) and capped (1,000 USDG per deposit, 10,000 USDG total); the shielded balance and withdrawals through the relayer are not linked to the agent wallet. Loans are a two-party flow: h081_loan_borrow pledges an allowance to a lender's terms and returns a proof code the lender funds against; nothing is borrowed until a lender funds. H081 Capital is live on Solana mainnet; it is not audited yet; use at your own risk.
